question: At what location and on what day may this rite be performed, even if the site is unconsecrated?
premises: The rite is associated with a kula day.
The location may be a funeral pyre.
The funeral pyre may be unconsecrated.
inference: On a kula day, the rite may be performed even on an unconsecrated funeral pyre.
plain_english: O great goddess, on a kula day, even on an unconsecrated funeral pyre.
